guides.directions: Follow the tunnel toward Stormveil's fog gate.
guides.conditions: Optional for overall story progression; required for the ordinary front route into Stormveil.
guides.combat: Delayed cane strikes, light blades and a later hammer leap. Do not dodge on wind-up alone.
guides.strategy: Roll into the final swing of a chain; punish hammer landings with a charged attack. Ranged builds should cast after a committed leap, not during his dagger throws. Margit's Shackle can create openings early.
guides.preparation: Suggested level 20–30, standard weapon +3 to +5; prioritize vigor.

guides.directions: Leave the grace and enter the nearby boss fog.
guides.conditions: Reach Stormveil's inner courtyard; optional shardbearer in the broader story.
guides.combat: Axe chains, wind bursts and a second phase with a dragon arm that breathes fire.
guides.strategy: Wait out the wind-up and move toward his flank after the rolling leap. During the transition's fire attack, close distance around the side rather than retreat straight through the flames. Use fast ranged casts after his axe slams.
guides.rewards: Godrick's Great Rune; Remembrance of the Grafted; 20,000 runes.
guides.preparation: Suggested level 30–40, standard weapon +5 to +8. Bleed may help.

guides.directions: Follow the slope north toward Church of Elleh; the mounted knight patrols between them.
guides.combat: Halberd sweeps, horse charges, shield slams; shield can punish spell projectiles.
guides.strategy: Let the horse finish a charge before striking its side. Avoid prolonged attacks under the shield; on Torrent make brief passes and disengage. Casters should wait for the shield to lower.
guides.preparation: Suggested level 25–35, standard weapon +3 or better.

guides.directions: Ride south into Agheel Lake toward the burned ruins and dragon landing area.
guides.combat: Ground and airborne fire breath, stomps, bites and tail swings.
guides.strategy: Use Torrent to clear the fire path laterally. Attack the head during breath recovery if safely reachable; otherwise take short hits at the legs and leave before a stomp. Ranged characters can reposition before firing.
guides.rewards: Dragon Heart; 5,000 runes; unlocks Agheel's Flame for purchase.
guides.preparation: Suggested level 25–35, standard weapon +3 to +5; fire protection helps.

guides.conditions: Optional evergaol; Blaidd may assist if his quest encounter is prepared. Ordinary spirit ashes unavailable.
guides.combat: Quick claw and curved sword chains, sudden repositioning and delayed follow-up swings.
guides.strategy: Use a short punish after the final leap or slash rather than attacking the disappearance. A shield or quick weapon helps; casters should use fast spells only when the knight finishes moving.
guides.preparation: Suggested level 20–30, standard weapon +3; avoid long casting animations.

guides.directions: Follow the ravine north from Agheel Lake, then enter the cave along its wall. Open the chest in the boss chamber.
guides.conditions: Stop attacking when Patches surrenders to preserve his merchant and quest.
guides.combat: Spear thrusts from behind a shield and short-range mist.
guides.strategy: Circle the shield rather than repeatedly striking its front; bait a committed thrust and punish from the side. Casters can keep distance from the mist. Do not use lingering damage once he is near surrender.
guides.rewards: Surrender resolves the encounter and unlocks his shop; do not require killing him.
guides.preparation: Early-game equipment is sufficient; avoid high burst near surrender.

guides.directions: Reach the western Limgrave beach below Church of Elleh and enter the cave in the cliff. Follow the tunnel to the dark chamber.
guides.conditions: Optional paired encounter; both chiefs must fall.
guides.combat: Two aggressive chiefs with smaller demi-human enemies in a dark arena.
guides.strategy: Eliminate nearby small enemies first and try to separate the chiefs. A torch or lantern improves visibility; use sweeping attacks only when both threats are visible. Ranged builds can move between openings instead of standing still.
guides.preparation: Suggested level 10–20 and an early weapon upgrade; bring a light source.

guides.directions: Enter the mine at the northern edge of Agheel Lake and descend its lifts to the lowest boss chamber.
guides.combat: Heavy club attacks, stomps and broad swings in a confined room.
guides.strategy: Use strike damage or magic rather than relying on light slashes against stone-like skin. Roll after the club commits and attack the legs; back away when it raises a foot. Cast during long recoveries.
guides.rewards: Roar Medallion; 1,800 runes. Older guide reward conflict requires patch review.
guides.preparation: Suggested level 15–25; bring a strike weapon if available.

guides.directions: Follow the Agheel ravine north past Murkwater Cave to the catacomb entrance; find its lever before returning to the boss door.
guides.combat: Aggressive dual-hammer combos and grab attempts.
guides.strategy: Let the chained hammer sequence finish before counterattacking; avoid hugging the boss while it reaches for a grab. Fast ranged attacks are safer after a committed slam.

guides.directions: Cross Castle Ensis to its final chamber and enter the boss fog.

guides.combat: Long paired-sword chains, magic projectiles, later fire and magic weapon buffs; twin moon shockwaves.

guides.rewards: Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight.

guides.strategy: Leave ground covered in ghostflame; move in after the breath finishes. Aim for head openings, and use short casts when it is stationary. Mounted repositioning can help if the fight spreads across the lake.
